title: Q1 2026: Beads Dashboard v1.0 - Production Ready
description:
Transform the current mockup into a production-ready Gantt dashboard with proper UX, architecture, and test coverage.

Key Results:
- Test coverage > 90% (unit + integration + E2E)
- Performance: Initial load < 2s, interactions < 100ms
- Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
- Mobile support: Responsive design working on all devices
- Real-time sync: Live updates via SSE

title: [ARCH] Architecture & Performance Sprint
description:
Fix architectural issues - connection pooling, caching, virtualization, real-time sync.

Key Results:
- Database connection pooling implemented
- API response time < 100ms (p95)
- Virtualized rendering for 1000+ rows
- Real-time updates via SSE
- Optimistic UI updates
- Error handling and validation (Zod) on all endpoints
- Cache-Control headers on all GET requests

title: [UX] UI/UX Improvements Sprint
description:
Address all UI/UX issues from design review - accessibility, mobile, interactions.

Key Results:
- WCAG 2.1 AA compliance (color contrast, keyboard nav, screen readers)
- Mobile/touch support fully functional
- Drag-and-drop for task scheduling
- Dependency arrows visualized
- Search and filter capability
- Dark/light theme toggle
- Minimap for timeline navigation
- Loading states and error handling

title: [TEST] Testing Infrastructure Sprint
description:
Build comprehensive test coverage - unit, component, integration, E2E.

Key Results:
- Unit test coverage > 90% (vitest)
- Component tests for all UI components (React Testing Library)
- Integration tests for all API routes
- E2E tests for critical user flows (Playwright)
- Test data fixtures and mocks ready
- CI pipeline running all tests on every PR

title: Add database connection pooling
description:
Implement connection pooling to prevent database connection exhaustion under load.

Success criteria:
- Connection pool configured with max connections limit
- Connection reuse working
- No connection leaks
- Tests verify pool behavior

title: Setup Vitest and React Testing Library
description:
Install and configure Vitest for unit testing and React Testing Library for component testing.

Success criteria:
- vitest.config.ts configured
- @testing-library/react installed
- Sample test passing
- npm test script working

title: Add keyboard navigation and focus management
description:
Implement full keyboard navigation for accessibility compliance.

Success criteria:
- Tab navigation works through all interactive elements
- Focus indicators visible
- Escape key closes modals
- Arrow keys navigate gantt chart
- Keyboard shortcuts documented
